requirements.text: Experience in developing production software in Python and/or Go
Strong foundations in data structures, algorithms, complexity analysis, concurrency, and modular software design
Experience building backend APIs and asynchronous services, including error handling, timeouts, retries, and failure recovery
Knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and relational databases,( familiarity with caching or NoSQL systems a plus)
Experience with Git, code reviews, unit and integration testing, CI/CD
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
Using software systems design tools and languages.
Ability to apply analytical and problem solving skills.
Designing software systems running on multiple platform types.
Software systems testing methodology, including execution of test plans, debugging, and testing scripts and tools.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language. Ability to effectively communicate design proposals and negotiate options.
Familiarity with cloud services and containerized applications, such as AWS and Docker
Cloud and distributed platforms: AWS services such as S3, DynamoDB, RDS/Aurora, SQS, IAM; Kubernetes and Helm; Kafka, Redis, OpenSearch
AI-assisted development: GitHub Copilot or comparable coding assistants, including reviewing generated code, verifying behavior through tests, and protecting sensitive information
Understanding of microservices architecture, API contracts, sync/async service-to-service communication
